loading: offline provenance authority only; not in runtime manifest, foundation, bundles, service worker or page loads

canonicalization.contentHash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 compact JSON (no BOM, no insignificant whitespace); object keys sorted by Unicode code point for hashing only; arrays keep source order
canonicalization.numbers: exact decimal parse of the source token (no binary float); canonical base-10 notation, insignificant fractional zeros removed, -0 -> 0; 1, 1.0 and 1e0 hash equal
canonicalization.rejected: NaN, Infinity and other non-JSON tokens fail parsing; duplicate object keys are kept as separate candidates/pairs with diagnostics
canonicalization.types: bool is distinct from number; null is distinct from an absent key
canonicalization.rawTokenHash: SHA-256 of the original UTF-8 byte slice of the definition object (whitespace inside the object included, per accepted R1 deferral)
canonicalization.tokenStreamHash: SHA-256 of the compact source-order serialization with original number tokens (whitespace removed); used only to classify changes

recordEdges.Buff->MonsterConditions: applyConditions, hideFromPlayerCondition and behaviorOverrides[] condition fields
recordEdges.MonsterConditions->MonsterConditions: keys of my/enemyTeamMonsterConditionMatchesNeeded, Last/NextReplacement fields, nested and/or/not
recordEdges.Buff->AbilityEffect(statusEffect): statusEffect: semantics unresolved, so it is kept in the digest conservatively

fieldRules.stackMembershipEdges: buffStackNames, stackNamesToBlock, buffStackNamesToEffect, and behaviorOverrides[].name when the aligned behavior is RemoveBuffs; the node hashes sorted member Buff IDs only
fieldRules.stackNamespaceAssumption: stack = explicit stackName, else the Buff's own ID
fieldRules.leafEdges: behaviors[] -> BattleBehavior (content hash), monsterType/randomMonsterTypeList -> Monster|Boss identity, weapon/weaponIfWrongHand -> Weapon identity
fieldRules.presentationEdges: effectToShowWhenApplied, abilityEffect, selfAbilityEffect, selfDamageEffect, effectName -> AbilityEffect: recorded, NOT followed or digested
fieldRules.unlistedFields: preserved raw with no edge; names listed in observedBehaviorInventory.fieldsWithoutReferenceRule (mostly scalar value fields; review new names on APK updates)
